description.p: Spun is a lightweight Sendspin client that wires Music Assistant to your Linux desktop's native multimedia controls and keyboard's media keys. It lives in your system tray, and is designed to require minimal setup and never to bother you unless something is wrong. Add it to your login items if you wish. When you (or your automations) want to play music or announce something, it dutifully does just that and then gets out of your way again.
